CVE-2026-71482.title: Amazon Linux 2023 - ALAS2023-2026-3450: Important priority package update for skopeo
CVE-2026-71482.description: When coalescing adjacent text nodes in addText and fosterParent, appending to an existing TextNode's Data via string concatenation (n.Data += text) reallocated and copied the accumulated string on every token. Inputs containing many short text runs separated by ignored end tags (such as 'a</x>') caused O(n^2) allocations and byte copies. Accumulate coalesced text in per-node byte slices during parsing and materialize Data strings once at the end of parse.
